instructions: Independent offer-QC is separate from existing humanVerified card approval. Research candidates are NOT published as live bonuses. candidate.offerDetails: Cardholder must qualify as a new eligible applicant. Chase lists a 24-month prior-bonus restriction, and excluded purchases do not count.

candidate.headline: Up to 115,000 Aeroplan bonus points across two spending milestones
candidate.offerDetails: The $20,000 milestone is the total within 12 months, not an additional $20,000 above the first milestone. Issuer page contains old and new figures simultaneously; confirm current channel terms before approving.

cards.researchNotes: Issuer page includes overlapping 60K and 115K content; check actual current offer page, eligibility, and rate/annual-fee changes. Do not approve without human source capture.

candidate.headline: $50 Amazon gift card upon approval, subject to eligibility
candidate.offerDetails: Amazon gift card is added to an eligible Amazon account at approval; there is no advertised minimum purchase spending requirement for this offer. This is Amazon Visa, not Prime Visa.

cards.researchNotes: Do not confuse Amazon Visa $50 with Prime Visa $150, whose membership eligibility differs. Approval and distribution can vary by offer channel.
